$comment: Single source of truth for toolchain versions the fleet standardizes on.
Nothing reads this at build time — each repo still declares its own pin in
the file its tooling actually reads (package.json packageManager, go.mod,
.node-version), because that is what corepack, setup-go and setup-node
consume both in CI and on a developer's machine. This file is what those
per-repo pins are checked AGAINST: tools/check-fleet-versions compares every
repo to the values here, so drift is a failing check rather than something
Bumping a version here is the start of a fleet wave, not the end: update the
value, then update every repo's own pin to match.
